031682a5e3585772:es.source:
- **What it touches.** In offline Club Mode (`league-tui`), `--save-dir` writes public `club-<id>.save.json`, private hot-seat `club-<id>.seal` (deleted upon successful replay export), verified `club-<id>.replay.json`, and optional `--log-file` metadata diagnostics (never logging PINs, Vault notes, mandates, staged orders, or commit salts, and redacting API/XRPL credentials and sealed JSON keys across all four log levels) on your own machine with zero network calls. In Game mode (not built yet), a player's Testnet keys stay on their own machine, in the git-ignored `.league/` folder, and are never logged. The paper-test relay reads its OpenRouter key only from the `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` environment variable and makes no OpenRouter call without `--live` and a credit cap. Its local seats refuse any API key, reach only a loopback address or a VM address you allow with `--allow-vm-host`, and need a GPU-seconds cap. It keeps its transcripts in the game folder you give it.
- **What it does not touch.** No real money, no Mainnet, and nothing outside the folders above. There is **no telemetry**: nothing is sent anywhere except the calls a mode needs (the Testnet, a public randomness beacon and, for the relay, OpenRouter or the local model servers you allow).
- **Permissions.** Network access to the Testnet in Game mode. Docker with `--network=none --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -v "$(pwd)/saves:/saves"` (or named volume `-v merchant-league-saves:/saves`) when running the local Club Mode container (touching only `/saves`), or Docker with its port bound to `127.0.0.1` only for the stand-alone harness.
- **Guards.** Every Testnet connection must report the Testnet's network id. A CI tripwire fails on any Mainnet hostname written in the repository outside vendored code, and a second one fails on copy that frames the game as a source of income. Review covers what a word list can't see.
031682a5e3585772:es.translation:
- **A qué accede.** En el modo Club sin conexión (`league-tui`), `--save-dir` escribe `club-<id>.save.json` públicos, `club-<id>.seal` privados de juego compartido (eliminados al exportar con éxito la repetición), `club-<id>.replay.json` verificados y diagnósticos de metadatos `--log-file` opcionales (nunca registra los PIN, las notas de la bóveda, los mandatos, las órdenes preparadas ni las sales de compromiso, y oculta las credenciales de API/XRPL y las claves JSON selladas en los cuatro niveles de registro) en su propia máquina, sin realizar ninguna llamada de red. En el modo de juego (aún no implementado), las claves de Testnet de un jugador permanecen en su propia máquina, en la carpeta `.league/` ignorada por Git, y nunca se registran. El relé de prueba en papel lee su clave OpenRouter solo de la variable de entorno `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` y no realiza ninguna llamada OpenRouter sin `--live` y un límite de crédito. Sus asientos locales rechazan cualquier clave de API, solo acceden a una dirección de bucle local (loopback) o a una dirección de máquina virtual que usted permite con `--allow-vm-host` y requieren un límite de segundos de GPU. Guarda sus transcripciones en la carpeta del juego que le proporcione.
- **A qué no accede.** No hay dinero real, ni Mainnet y nada fuera de las carpetas anteriores. No hay **telemetría**: no se envía nada a ningún lugar, excepto las llamadas que necesita un modo (Testnet, un faro de aleatoriedad público y, para el relé, OpenRouter o los servidores de modelo locales que usted permite).
- **Permisos.** Acceso a la red de Testnet en el modo de juego. Docker con `--network=none --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -v "$(pwd)/saves:/saves"` (o volumen con nombre `-v merchant-league-saves:/saves`) al ejecutar el contenedor local del modo Club (solo accede a `/saves`), o Docker con su puerto vinculado a `127.0.0.1` solo para el conjunto independiente.

Un control de CI falla ante cualquier nombre de host de Mainnet escrito en el repositorio fuera del código de terceros incluido (vendored), y otro falla ante textos que presenten el juego como una fuente de ingresos. La revisión cubre lo que una lista de palabras no puede ver.

- **यह क्या छूता है।** ऑफ़लाइन क्लब मोड (`league-tui`) में, `--save-dir` सार्वजनिक `club-<id>.save.json`, निजी हॉट-सीट `club-<id>.seal` (सफल रीप्ले निर्यात पर हटा दिया जाता है), सत्यापित `club-<id>.replay.json` और वैकल्पिक `--log-file` मेटाडेटा डायग्नोस्टिक्स (कभी भी पिन, वॉल्ट नोट्स, जनादेश, स्टेज किए गए ऑर्डर या कमिट सॉल्ट लॉग नहीं करता है, और सभी चार लॉग स्तरों में API/XRPL क्रेडेंशियल्स और सीलबंद JSON कुंजियों को छिपा देता है) आपकी अपनी मशीन पर, बिना किसी नेटवर्क कॉल के, लिखता है। गेम मोड में (अभी तक नहीं बनाया गया), एक खिलाड़ी की टेस्टनेट कुंजियाँ उनकी अपनी मशीन पर, git-अनदेखे `.league/` फ़ोल्डर में रहती हैं, और कभी भी लॉग नहीं की जाती हैं। पेपर-टेस्ट रिले केवल `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` पर्यावरण चर से अपनी OpenRouter कुंजी पढ़ता है और `--live` और क्रेडिट कैप के बिना कोई OpenRouter कॉल नहीं करता है। इसकी स्थानीय सीटें किसी भी API कुंजी को अस्वीकार करती हैं, केवल एक लूपबैक पते या एक VM पते तक पहुँचती हैं जिसे आप `--allow-vm-host` के साथ अनुमति देते हैं, और GPU-सेकंड कैप की आवश्यकता होती है। यह अपने ट्रांसक्रिप्ट को उस गेम फ़ोल्डर में रखता है जो आप इसे देते हैं।
- **यह क्या नहीं छूता।** कोई वास्तविक पैसा नहीं, कोई मेननेट नहीं, और ऊपर दिए गए फ़ोल्डरों के बाहर कुछ भी नहीं। कोई टेलीमेट्री नहीं है: कुछ भी कहीं भी नहीं भेजा जाता है, सिवाय उन कॉलों के जिनकी एक मोड को आवश्यकता होती है (टेस्टनेट, एक सार्वजनिक यादृच्छिकता बीकन और, रिले के लिए, OpenRouter या स्थानीय मॉडल सर्वर जिसे आप अनुमति देते हैं)।
- **अनुमतियाँ।** गेम मोड में टेस्टनेट तक नेटवर्क एक्सेस। डॉकर `--network=none --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -v "$(pwd)/saves:/saves"` (या नामित वॉल्यूम `-v merchant-league-saves:/saves`) के साथ जब स्थानीय क्लब मोड कंटेनर चल रहा हो (केवल `/saves` को छूता है), या डॉकर जिसके पोर्ट को केवल स्टैंड-अलोन हार्नेस के लिए `127.0.0.1` पर बांधा गया है।
- **सुरक्षा उपाय।** प्रत्येक टेस्टनेट कनेक्शन को टेस्टनेट के नेटवर्क आईडी की रिपोर्ट करनी चाहिए। रिपॉजिटरी में वेंडर्ड (तृतीय-पक्ष) कोड के बाहर कहीं भी कोई मेननेट होस्टनाम लिखा हो, तो एक CI ट्रिपवायर विफल हो जाता है, और दूसरा उस पाठ पर विफल हो जाता है जो गेम को आय के स्रोत के रूप में प्रस्तुत करता है। समीक्षा में वह सब शामिल है जो एक शब्द सूची नहीं देख सकती।

In Game mode (not built yet), a player's Testnet keys stay on their own machine, in the git-ignored `.league/` folder, and are never logged. The paper-test relay reads its OpenRouter key only from the `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` environment variable and makes no OpenRouter call without `--live` and a credit cap. Its local seats refuse any API key, reach only a loopback address or a VM address you allow with `--allow-vm-host`, and need a GPU-seconds cap. It keeps its transcripts in the game folder you give it.
- **What it does not touch.** No real money, no Mainnet, and nothing outside the folders above. There is **no telemetry**: nothing is sent anywhere except the calls a mode needs (the Testnet, a public randomness beacon and, for the relay, OpenRouter or the local model servers you allow).
- **Permissions.** Network access to the Testnet in Game mode. Docker with `--network=none --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -v "$(pwd)/saves:/saves"` (or named volume `-v merchant-league-saves:/saves`) when running the local Club Mode container (touching only `/saves`), or Docker with its port bound to `127.0.0.1` only for the stand-alone harness.
- **Guards.** Every Testnet connection must report the Testnet's network id. A CI tripwire fails on any Mainnet hostname written in the repository outside vendored code, and a second one fails on copy that frames the game as a source of income. Review covers what a word list can't see.

09130d002b90b204:es.source:
- **Lobby setup:** Choose seat count (`4–6`, `Left`/`Right`), toggle each seat between `Human` and `ClubBot` (`Space`), enter a clear `SeedPool::Dev` seed in `0..=9999` (reserved test seeds and other pools are refused by name), choose a turn budget (`180–300 s`, `210 s` default, or `Untimed` with `Space`), and toggle 4-digit table-local Curtain PINs. Press `Enter` on **Start Club Mode Table**. Starting while an unfinished `club-*.seal` exists in `--save-dir` is refused (`UNFINISHED_SEASON_EXISTS`); once exported, the next table receives the next free table ID without overwriting prior saves. Command-line flags (`--turn-clock`, `--untimed`, `--pins`) override conflicting Lobby and saved `.seal` choices (`league-tui --help` documents precedence; passing PIN digits via `--pin` on the CLI is refused).
- **Turn keys:** `1`/`2`/`3`/`Tab`/`BackTab` switch enabled composer tabs (`4: Diplomatic Desk (Disabled)` stays disabled); `F6` cycles focus across the Public Ledger, Composer Tabs, and Private Vault; `[`/`]` cycles action kinds or bundle sections; `Up`/`Down`/`PageUp`/`PageDown`/`Home` selects or scrolls; `Left`/`Right`/`+`/`-`/`Space` adjusts fields; `e` edits free-text overrides; `n` edits personal Private Vault notes; `Enter` submits an action, stages a bundle section, or runs the `p` What-If Sandbox; `Del`/`Backspace`/`X` clears staged orders; `c` toggles guild good names vs 3-letter codes (`[CRED]`, `[TMB]`); `r`/`F2` opens the Sweep Chronicle modal; `Ctrl+l`/`Ctrl+L` locks your pass and opens the Privacy Curtain; `q`/`Esc`/`Ctrl+c` quits cleanly.
- **Privacy Curtain, dead time & PINs:** Every hand-off, timeout, and in-season resume opens a public Privacy Curtain (clearing the alternate screen in place with `CSI 2 J` and never `CSI 3 J` scrollback purge), drains queued input, and enforces a `400 ms` input dead time both when opening and when lifting (lift dead time does not count against the arriving seat's clock). Press `Space` then `Enter` to lift; if PINs are enabled, type your masked 4-digit PIN (entered only behind the Curtain — the 1st turn sets it, later hand-offs verify it, wrong tries build zero seat observations, and 3 misses reset back to the unarmed Curtain).
- **Clock:** Timed turns split each budget `75%` Sub-Pass A / `25%` Sub-Pass B across all `H` human seats (`floor(0.75 * B / H)` s and `floor(0.25 * B / H)` s). Locking early advances immediately; idle Sub-Pass B timeouts resolve via the Standing Regent fallback doctrine.
- **Save & resume:** With `--save-dir <DIR>`, the host autosaves atomically at every Curtain, initial PIN commit, and Sweep leaving `TalkAndMarket`. Public state saves to `club-<id>.save.json`; hidden mandates, salts, pre-derived VRF proofs, notes, uncommitted bundles, and PINs stay solely in `club-<id>.seal`. Resume any time with `cargo run -p league-tui --locked -- --resume ./saves/club-1.save.json` (or `--resume ./saves`, selecting the active `.seal` table): in-season resumes always land behind the active human seat's Curtain with a fresh pass clock (advancing any leading `ClubBot` cursors first), while post-season resumes land directly on the public `Session Standby` reveal screen (`AwaitingMandateReveal`) or `Completed` End-of-Season tabs so you can retry replay export. Passing `--resume` together with a different `--save-dir` is refused when that directory holds another `club-*.seal` file (`UNFINISHED_SEASON_EXISTS`, any table ID) or otherwise holds `club-<id>.save.json`, `.seal` or `.replay.json` for the same table ID (`SEASON_SAVE_EXISTS`, except when resuming a finished season whose own byte-identical regular `club-<id>.replay.json` is already in that directory with no conflicting `.save.json` or `.seal`, so an export retry after a failed source-`.seal` wipe proceeds); a directory holding only a finished, exported season with a different table ID is accepted without overwriting anything. Targeting a missing or empty `--save-dir` creates it if needed when exporting and still wipes the resumed `.seal` on successful export. An in-season resume into another `--save-dir` continues the season there and leaves the original directory's `club-<id>.save.json` and `.seal` in place. Exporting the replay in that same session wipes the original `.seal` too; if you instead quit and later resume from the new directory, the original `.seal` stays, still holding that season's private values and keeping the original directory's Lobby refusing a new season (`UNFINISHED_SEASON_EXISTS`). Delete that leftover copy only after you have quit and the season has saved in the new directory. Apart from that leftover, keep each season's `club-<id>.save.json`, `.seal` and `.replay.json` under the names and in the directory `league-tui` gave them; to move a season elsewhere, resume it with `--save-dir <EMPTY_DIR>` rather than renaming or moving the files by hand.
- **End of season & replay export:** After the Closing Bell closes `TalkAndMarket`, step through the public standby mandate-reveal stage (`Enter`/`Space` per seat, showing zero mandates beforehand) to finalize into the four-tab End-of-Season screen (`1: Scoreboard`, `2: Mandates`, `3: Metrics & Marks`, `4: Replay Export`). On Tab 4, press `e` or `Enter` to write and verify `club-<id>.replay.json` and wipe the private `.seal` file (if another season's replay already occupies that target path, export refuses `REPLAY_TARGET_EXISTS` without overwriting it; if export fails, `.seal` stays on disk so you can retry).
09130d002b90b204:es.translation:
- **Configuración del lobby:** Elige el número de asientos (`4–6`, `Left`/`Right`), alterna cada asiento entre `Human` y `ClubBot` (`Space`), introduce una semilla `SeedPool::Dev` en claro dentro de `0..=9999` (las semillas de prueba reservadas y los demás grupos se rechazan por nombre), elige el tiempo por turno (`180–300 s`, `210 s` por defecto, o `Untimed` con `Space`) y activa o desactiva los PIN de Cortina de 4 dígitos propios de la mesa. Pulsa `Enter` en **Start Club Mode Table**. Empezar mientras exista un `club-*.seal` sin terminar en `--save-dir` se rechaza (`UNFINISHED_SEASON_EXISTS`); una vez exportada, la mesa siguiente recibe el siguiente ID de mesa libre sin sobrescribir las partidas guardadas anteriores. Las opciones de línea de comandos (`--turn-clock`, `--untimed`, `--pins`) prevalecen sobre las elecciones del lobby y del `.seal` guardado que entren en conflicto (`league-tui --help` documenta la precedencia; pasar los dígitos del PIN con `--pin` en la línea de comandos se rechaza).
- **Teclas del turno:** `1`/`2`/`3`/`Tab`/`BackTab` cambian entre las pestañas del compositor habilitadas (`4: Diplomatic Desk (Disabled)` sigue deshabilitada); `F6` mueve el foco entre el Libro público, las pestañas del compositor y la Bóveda privada; `[`/`]` recorren los tipos de acción o las secciones del paquete; `Up`/`Down`/`PageUp`/`PageDown`/`Home` seleccionan o desplazan; `Left`/`Right`/`+`/`-`/`Space` ajustan campos; `e` edita sustituciones de texto libre; `n` edita las notas personales de la Bóveda privada; `Enter` envía una acción, prepara una sección del paquete o ejecuta el Sandbox What-If de `p`; `Del`/`Backspace`/`X` borran las órdenes preparadas; `c` alterna entre los nombres de bienes del gremio y los códigos de 3 letras (`[CRED]`, `[TMB]`); `r`/`F2` abre la ventana de la Crónica del barrido; `Ctrl+l`/`Ctrl+L` bloquea tu pase y abre la Cortina de privacidad; `q`/`Esc`/`Ctrl+c` salen limpiamente.
- **Cortina de privacidad, tiempo muerto y PIN:** Cada traspaso, tiempo agotado y reanudación a mitad de temporada abre una Cortina de privacidad pública (borra la pantalla alternativa en su sitio con `CSI 2 J` y nunca con `CSI 3 J`, que purga el historial de desplazamiento), descarta la entrada en cola y aplica un tiempo muerto de entrada de `400 ms` tanto al abrirla como al levantarla (el tiempo muerto al levantarla no cuenta en el reloj del asiento que llega). Pulsa `Space` y luego `Enter` para levantarla; si los PIN están activados, escribe tu PIN de 4 dígitos enmascarado (solo se introduce tras la Cortina: el 1.er turno lo fija, los traspasos siguientes lo verifican, los intentos fallidos no generan ninguna vista de asiento y 3 fallos devuelven la Cortina a su estado sin armar).
- **Reloj:** Los turnos con tiempo reparten cada presupuesto `75%` para el Subpase A / `25%` para el Subpase B entre los `H` asientos humanos (`floor(0.75 * B / H)` s y `floor(0.25 * B / H)` s). Bloquear antes avanza de inmediato; los tiempos agotados por inactividad en el Subpase B se resuelven con la doctrina de respaldo del Regente permanente.
- **Guardar y reanudar:** Con `--save-dir <DIR>`, el anfitrión guarda automáticamente de forma atómica en cada Cortina, en el primer compromiso de PIN y en el barrido que sale de `TalkAndMarket`. El estado público se guarda en `club-<id>.save.json`; los mandatos ocultos, las sales, las pruebas VRF derivadas de antemano, las notas, los paquetes sin comprometer y los PIN se quedan únicamente en `club-<id>.seal`. Reanuda cuando quieras con `cargo run -p league-tui --locked -- --resume ./saves/club-1.save.json` (o `--resume ./saves`, que selecciona la mesa del `.seal` activo): las reanudaciones a mitad de temporada siempre llegan tras la Cortina del asiento humano activo con un reloj de pase nuevo (avanzando primero los cursores de `ClubBot` que vayan delante), mientras que las reanudaciones después de la temporada llegan directamente a la pantalla pública de revelación `Session Standby` (`AwaitingMandateReveal`) o a las pestañas de fin de temporada `Completed`, para que puedas reintentar la exportación de la repetición. Pasar `--resume` junto con un `--save-dir` distinto se rechaza cuando ese directorio contiene otro archivo `club-*.seal` (`UNFINISHED_SEASON_EXISTS`, con cualquier ID de mesa) o contiene `club-<id>.save.json`, `.seal` o `.replay.json` del mismo ID de mesa (`SEASON_SAVE_EXISTS`, salvo al reanudar una temporada terminada cuyo propio `club-<id>.replay.json` normal, idéntico byte a byte, ya está en ese directorio sin un `.save.json` o `.seal` en conflicto, de modo que un reintento de exportación tras un borrado fallido del `.seal` de origen sigue adelante); un directorio que solo contiene una temporada terminada y exportada con otro ID de mesa se acepta sin sobrescribir nada. Indicar un `--save-dir` inexistente o vacío lo crea si hace falta al exportar y sigue borrando el `.seal` reanudado si la exportación tiene éxito. Una reanudación a mitad de temporada en otro `--save-dir` continúa la temporada allí y deja en su sitio el `club-<id>.save.json` y el `.seal` del directorio original. Exportar la repetición en esa misma sesión también borra el `.seal` original; si en cambio sales y más tarde reanudas desde el directorio nuevo, el `.seal` original se queda, todavía con los valores privados de esa temporada, y hace que el lobby del directorio original siga rechazando una temporada nueva (`UNFINISHED_SEASON_EXISTS`). Borra esa copia sobrante solo después de haber salido y de que la temporada se haya guardado en el directorio nuevo. Aparte de esa copia sobrante, mantén el `club-<id>.save.json`, el `.seal` y el `.replay.json` de cada temporada con los nombres y en el directorio que les dio `league-tui`; para mover una temporada a otro sitio, reanúdala con `--save-dir <EMPTY_DIR>` en lugar de renombrar o mover los archivos a mano.
- **Fin de temporada y exportación de la repetición:** Después de que la Campana de cierre cierre `TalkAndMarket`, avanza por la etapa pública de espera con revelación de mandatos (`Enter`/`Space` por asiento, sin mostrar ningún mandato antes) para pasar a la pantalla de fin de temporada con cuatro pestañas (`1: Scoreboard`, `2: Mandates`, `3: Metrics & Marks`, `4: Replay Export`). En la pestaña 4, pulsa `e` o `Enter` para escribir y verificar `club-<id>.replay.json` y borrar el archivo privado `.seal` (si la repetición de otra temporada ya ocupa esa ruta de destino, la exportación se rechaza con `REPLAY_TARGET_EXISTS` sin sobrescribirla; si la exportación falla, el `.seal` se queda en disco para que puedas reintentarlo).

- **Lobby setup:** Choose seat count (`4–6`, `Left`/`Right`), toggle each seat between `Human` and `ClubBot` (`Space`), enter a clear `SeedPool::Dev` seed in `0..=9999` (reserved test seeds and other pools are refused by name), choose a turn budget (`180–300 s`, `210 s` default, or `Untimed` with `Space`), and toggle 4-digit table-local Curtain PINs. Press `Enter` on **Start Club Mode Table**. Starting while an unfinished `club-*.seal` exists in `--save-dir` is refused (`UNFINISHED_SEASON_EXISTS`); once exported, the next table receives the next free table ID without overwriting prior saves. Command-line flags (`--turn-clock`, `--untimed`, `--pins`) override conflicting Lobby and saved `.seal` choices (`league-tui --help` documents precedence; passing PIN digits via `--pin` on the CLI is refused).

- **Clock:** Timed turns split each budget `75%` Sub-Pass A / `25%` Sub-Pass B across all `H` human seats (`floor(0.75 * B / H)` s and `floor(0.25 * B / H)` s). Locking early advances immediately; idle Sub-Pass B timeouts resolve via the Standing Regent fallback doctrine.

Public state saves to `club-<id>.save.json`; hidden mandates, salts, pre-derived VRF proofs, notes, uncommitted bundles, and PINs stay solely in `club-<id>.seal`. Targeting a missing or empty `--save-dir` creates it if needed when exporting and still wipes the resumed `.seal` on successful export. An in-season resume into another `--save-dir` continues the season there and leaves the original directory's `club-<id>.save.json` and `.seal` in place. Exporting the replay in that same session wipes the original `.seal` too; if you instead quit and later resume from the new directory, the original `.seal` stays, still holding that season's private values and keeping the original directory's Lobby refusing a new season (`UNFINISHED_SEASON_EXISTS`). Delete that leftover copy only after you have quit and the season has saved in the new directory. Apart from that leftover, keep each season's `club-<id>.save.json`, `.seal` and `.replay.json` under the names and in the directory `league-tui` gave them; to move a season elsewhere, resume it with `--save-dir <EMPTY_DIR>` rather than renaming or moving the files by hand.
- **End of season & replay export:** After the Closing Bell closes `TalkAndMarket`, step through the public standby mandate-reveal stage (`Enter`/`Space` per seat, showing zero mandates beforehand) to finalize into the four-tab End-of-Season screen (`1: Scoreboard`, `2: Mandates`, `3: Metrics & Marks`, `4: Replay Export`). On Tab 4, press `e` or `Enter` to write and verify `club-<id>.replay.json` and wipe the private `.seal` file (if another season's replay already occupies that target path, export refuses `REPLAY_TARGET_EXISTS` without overwriting it; if export fails, `.seal` stays on disk so you can retry).

- **Orologio:** I turni a tempo dividono ogni budget in `75%` per il sotto-passaggio A e `25%` per il sotto-passaggio B tra tutti gli `H` posti umani (`floor(0.75 * B / H)` s e `floor(0.25 * B / H)` s). Bloccare in anticipo fa avanzare subito; i timeout per inattività nel sotto-passaggio B si risolvono con la dottrina di riserva del Reggente permanente.
- **Salvataggio e ripresa:** Con `--save-dir <DIR>`, l’host salva automaticamente in modo atomico a ogni sipario, al primo impegno del PIN e allo sweep che lascia `TalkAndMarket`. Lo stato pubblico viene salvato in `club-<id>.save.json`; i mandati nascosti, i sali, le prove VRF derivate in anticipo, le note, i pacchetti non impegnati e i PIN restano solo in `club-<id>.seal`. Riprendi quando vuoi con `cargo run -p league-tui --locked -- --resume ./saves/club-1.save.json` (oppure `--resume ./saves`, che seleziona il tavolo del `.seal` attivo): una ripresa a stagione in corso arriva sempre dietro il sipario del posto umano attivo con un nuovo orologio del passaggio (facendo prima avanzare eventuali cursori `ClubBot` precedenti), mentre una ripresa a stagione finita arriva direttamente sulla schermata pubblica di rivelazione `Session Standby` (`AwaitingMandateReveal`) o sulle schede di fine stagione `Completed`, così puoi riprovare l’esportazione del replay. Passare `--resume` insieme a un `--save-dir` diverso viene rifiutato quando quella directory contiene un altro file `club-*.seal` (`UNFINISHED_SEASON_EXISTS`, con qualsiasi ID di tavolo) oppure contiene `club-<id>.save.json`, `.seal` o `.replay.json` dello stesso ID di tavolo (`SEASON_SAVE_EXISTS`, tranne quando si riprende una stagione conclusa il cui `club-<id>.replay.json` regolare, identico byte per byte, è già in quella directory senza un `.save.json` o un `.seal` in conflitto, così che un nuovo tentativo di esportazione dopo una cancellazione fallita del `.seal` di origine vada avanti); una directory che contiene solo una stagione conclusa ed esportata con un altro ID di tavolo viene accettata senza sovrascrivere nulla. Indicare un `--save-dir` mancante o vuoto lo crea se serve durante l’esportazione, e il `.seal` ripreso viene comunque cancellato se l’esportazione riesce. Una ripresa a stagione in corso in un altro `--save-dir` prosegue lì la stagione e lascia al loro posto il `club-<id>.save.json` e il `.seal` della directory originale. Esportare il replay nella stessa sessione cancella anche il `.seal` originale; se invece esci e riprendi più tardi dalla nuova directory, il `.seal` originale resta, contiene ancora i valori privati di quella stagione e fa sì che la lobby della directory originale continui a rifiutare una nuova stagione (`UNFINISHED_SEASON_EXISTS`). Elimina quella copia rimasta solo dopo essere uscito e quando la stagione è salvata nella nuova directory. A parte quella copia rimasta, tieni il `club-<id>.save.json`, il `.seal` e il `.replay.json` di ogni stagione con i nomi e nella directory che `league-tui` ha dato loro; per spostare una stagione altrove, riprendila con `--save-dir <EMPTY_DIR>` invece di rinominare o spostare i file a mano.
- **Fine stagione ed esportazione del replay:** Dopo che la campana di chiusura ha chiuso `TalkAndMarket`, avanza nella fase pubblica di attesa e rivelazione dei mandati (`Enter`/`Space` per ogni posto, nessun mandato mostrato prima) fino alla schermata di fine stagione con quattro schede (`1: Scoreboard`, `2: Mandates`, `3: Metrics & Marks`, `4: Replay Export`). Nella scheda 4, premi `e` o `Enter` per scrivere e verificare `club-<id>.replay.json` e cancellare il file privato `.seal` (se il replay di un’altra stagione occupa già quel percorso di destinazione, l’esportazione viene rifiutata con `REPLAY_TARGET_EXISTS` senza sovrascriverlo; se l’esportazione non riesce, il `.seal` resta su disco così puoi riprovare).

Passing `--resume` together with a different `--save-dir` is refused when that directory holds another `club-*.seal` file (`UNFINISHED_SEASON_EXISTS`, any table ID) or otherwise holds `club-<id>.save.json`, `.seal` or `.replay.json` for the same table ID (`SEASON_SAVE_EXISTS`, except when resuming a finished season whose own byte-identical regular `club-<id>.replay.json` is already in that directory with no conflicting `.save.json` or `.seal`, so an export retry after a failed source-`.seal` wipe proceeds); a directory holding only a finished, exported season with a different table ID is accepted without overwriting anything. Targeting a missing or empty `--save-dir` creates it if needed when exporting and still wipes the resumed `.seal` on successful export. An in-season resume into another `--save-dir` continues the season there and leaves the original directory's `club-<id>.save.json` and `.seal` in place. Exporting the replay in that same session wipes the original `.seal` too; if you instead quit and later resume from the new directory, the original `.seal` stays, still holding that season's private values and keeping the original directory's Lobby refusing a new season (`UNFINISHED_SEASON_EXISTS`). Delete that leftover copy only after you have quit and the season has saved in the new directory. Apart from that leftover, keep each season's `club-<id>.save.json`, `.seal` and `.replay.json` under the names and in the directory `league-tui` gave them; to move a season elsewhere, resume it with `--save-dir <EMPTY_DIR>` rather than renaming or moving the files by hand.
- **End of season & replay export:** After the Closing Bell closes `TalkAndMarket`, step through the public standby mandate-reveal stage (`Enter`/`Space` per seat, showing zero mandates beforehand) to finalize into the four-tab End-of-Season screen (`1: Scoreboard`, `2: Mandates`, `3: Metrics & Marks`, `4: Replay Export`). On Tab 4, press `e` or `Enter` to write and verify `club-<id>.replay.json` and wipe the private `.seal` file (if another season's replay already occupies that target path, export refuses `REPLAY_TARGET_EXISTS` without overwriting it; if export fails, `.seal` stays on disk so you can retry).

- **大厅设置：** 选择座位数（`4–6`，`Left`/`Right`），在 `Human` 和 `ClubBot` 之间切换每个座位（`Space`），输入 `0..=9999` 范围内一个明确的 `SeedPool::Dev` 种子（保留的测试种子和其他种子池会被按名称拒绝），选择回合时限（`180–300 s`，默认 `210 s`，或用 `Space` 选择 `Untimed`），并开关四位数的本桌幕布 PIN。在 **Start Club Mode Table** 上按 `Enter`。如果 `--save-dir` 中存在未完成的 `club-*.seal`，开局会被拒绝（`UNFINISHED_SEASON_EXISTS`）；导出之后，下一桌会得到下一个空闲的桌号，不会覆盖之前的存档。命令行参数（`--turn-clock`、`--untimed`、`--pins`）会覆盖与之冲突的大厅选择和已保存的 `.seal` 选择（`league-tui --help` 说明了优先级；在命令行用 `--pin` 传入 PIN 数字会被拒绝）。
- **回合按键：** `1`/`2`/`3`/`Tab`/`BackTab` 切换已启用的编辑标签页（`4: Diplomatic Desk (Disabled)` 保持禁用）；`F6` 在公共账本、编辑标签页和私人保险库之间循环焦点；`[`/`]` 循环切换行动类型或订单包的各部分；`Up`/`Down`/`PageUp`/`PageDown`/`Home` 选择或滚动；`Left`/`Right`/`+`/`-`/`Space` 调整字段；`e` 编辑自由文本覆盖；`n` 编辑个人私人保险库笔记；`Enter` 提交一个行动、暂存订单包的一部分，或运行 `p` What-If 沙盒；`Del`/`Backspace`/`X` 清除已暂存的订单；`c` 在公会商品名和三字母代码（`[CRED]`、`[TMB]`）之间切换；`r`/`F2` 打开清算编年史窗口；`Ctrl+l`/`Ctrl+L` 锁定你的回合并打开隐私幕布；`q`/`Esc`/`Ctrl+c` 干净地退出。
- **隐私幕布、静默时间和 PIN：** 每次交接、超时和赛季中的恢复都会打开公共的隐私幕布（就地用 `CSI 2 J` 清空备用屏幕，从不使用会清除回滚记录的 `CSI 3 J`），清空排队的输入，并在打开和抬起时都强制 `400 ms` 的输入静默时间（抬起时的静默时间不计入到达座位的计时）。按 `Space` 再按 `Enter` 抬起幕布；如果启用了 PIN，输入你被遮挡显示的四位数 PIN（只在幕布后输入——第 1 回合设置它，之后的交接验证它，输错时不会生成任何座位视图，连续 3 次输错会使幕布退回尚未准备输入的初始状态）。
- **计时：** 计时回合把每次的时限按 `75%` 子阶段 A / `25%` 子阶段 B 分配给全部 `H` 个人类座位（`floor(0.75 * B / H)` 秒和 `floor(0.25 * B / H)` 秒）。提前锁定会立即推进；子阶段 B 空闲超时按常任摄政的后备规则处理。
- **保存与恢复：** 使用 `--save-dir <DIR>` 时，主机会在每次幕布、首次提交 PIN 以及离开 `TalkAndMarket` 的清算时原子地自动保存。公共状态保存到 `club-<id>.save.json`；隐藏的任务、盐值、预先导出的 VRF 证明、笔记、未提交的订单包和 PIN 只保存在 `club-<id>.seal` 中。随时可以用 `cargo run -p league-tui --locked -- --resume ./saves/club-1.save.json`（或 `--resume ./saves`，选择当前的 `.seal` 桌）恢复：赛季中的恢复总是落在当前人类座位的幕布后面，并重置回合计时（先推进排在前面的 `ClubBot` 游标），而赛季结束后的恢复直接进入公共的 `Session Standby` 揭示界面（`AwaitingMandateReveal`）或 `Completed` 的赛季结束标签页，方便你重试导出回放。同时传入 `--resume` 和另一个 `--save-dir` 时，如果该目录中有另一个 `club-*.seal` 文件（`UNFINISHED_SEASON_EXISTS`，任何桌号），或有同一桌号的 `club-<id>.save.json`、`.seal` 或 `.replay.json`（`SEASON_SAVE_EXISTS`），就会被拒绝；例外是恢复一个已结束的赛季、且该目录中已有它自己逐字节相同的常规 `club-<id>.replay.json`、没有冲突的 `.save.json` 或 `.seal`，这样在源 `.seal` 清除失败之后重试导出可以继续进行。一个只包含另一个桌号的已结束且已导出赛季的目录会被接受，不会覆盖任何内容。指定一个不存在或为空的 `--save-dir` 时，导出时会按需创建它，并在导出成功后仍然清除被恢复的 `.seal`。在赛季中恢复到另一个 `--save-dir` 会在那里继续赛季，并把原目录中的 `club-<id>.save.json` 和 `.seal` 留在原处。在同一次会话中导出回放也会清除原来的 `.seal`；如果你改为退出并稍后从新目录恢复，原来的 `.seal` 会保留，其中仍有该赛季的私密数据，并会让原目录的大厅继续拒绝开始新赛季（`UNFINISHED_SEASON_EXISTS`）。只有在你已退出且赛季已保存在新目录之后，才删除那份残留的副本。除了那份残留之外，请让每个赛季的 `club-<id>.save.json`、`.seal` 和 `.replay.json` 保持 `league-tui` 给它们的文件名和所在目录；要把赛季移到别处，请用 `--save-dir <EMPTY_DIR>` 恢复它，而不要手动重命名或移动文件。
- **赛季结束与导出回放：** 收盘钟声结束 `TalkAndMarket` 之后，逐步完成公共的待命任务揭示阶段（每个座位按 `Enter`/`Space`，在此之前不显示任何任务），进入有四个标签页的赛季结束界面（`1: Scoreboard`、`2: Mandates`、`3: Metrics & Marks`、`4: Replay Export`）。在第 4 个标签页按 `e` 或 `Enter`，写入并验证 `club-<id>.replay.json`，并清除私密的 `.seal` 文件（如果目标路径已被另一个赛季的回放占用，导出会以 `REPLAY_TARGET_EXISTS` 拒绝且不覆盖它；如果导出失败，`.seal` 会留在磁盘上，方便你重试）。

- **What it touches.** In Game mode (not built yet), a player's Testnet keys stay on their own machine, in the git-ignored `.league/` folder, and are never logged. It keeps its transcripts in the game folder you give it.

- **Guards.** Every Testnet connection must report the Testnet's network id. A CI tripwire fails on any Mainnet hostname written in the repository outside vendored code, and a second one fails on copy that frames the game as a source of income. Review covers what a word list can't see.

- **A ring of merchants.** Each seat produces its own raw good and needs goods from the other seats to pay its upkeep, run its workshops and deliver to shared projects. Nobody can prosper alone, and no small group can either.
- **Simultaneous turns.** Every turn has three phases. Seats talk and trade in the open market; then each seat commits its orders in secret; then every seat's orders resolve at once, by the same rules for everyone.
- **Politics.** Councils set tariffs, cartels can open private markets, and charters rotate between seats through the season.
- **A season of 24 to 32 turns.** Shocks (a supply freeze, a tariff holiday, a demand surge or a spoilage spike) are forecast publicly a turn before they land, and the last turn is rolled, so nobody can plan a perfect final move.

- **一个商人圈。** 每个玩家生产自己的原材料，需要从其他玩家那里获取商品，以支付运营成本、运营工作室并交付到共享项目中。没有人可以单独繁荣，也没有小团体可以做到。
